sql.query: WITH RECURSIVE acct_tree AS ( SELECT n.node_id, n.parent_id FROM ad_treenode n WHERE n.ad_tree_id = COALESCE( (SELECT e.ad_tree_id FROM c_acctschema_element ase JOIN c_element e ON e.c_element_id = ase.c_element_id WHERE ase.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__' AND ase.elementtype = 'AC' LIMIT 1), (SELECT t.ad_tree_id FROM ad_tree t WHERE t.treetype = 'EV' AND t.isactive = 'Y' AND t.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') LIMIT 1)) ), base AS ( SELECT fa.account_id, bp.name AS bpname, p.name AS productname, pj.name AS projectname, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct < '__DATEFROM__'::date OR (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctdr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_debit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_credit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date THEN fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closing_balance FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue lev ON lev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id LEFT JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = fa.c_bpartner_id LEFT JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = fa.m_product_id LEFT JOIN c_project pj ON pj.c_project_id = fa.c_project_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND fa.factaccttype NOT IN ('R', 'C') AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id = '__ORGID__') AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY fa.account_id, bp.name, p.name, pj.name ), acct_anc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.account_id AS leaf_id, b.account_id AS anc_id FROM base b UNION SELECT a.leaf_id, t.parent_id FROM acct_anc a JOIN acct_tree t ON t.node_id = a.anc_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_id <> '0' ) SELECT ev.value AS account_no, ev.c_elementvalue_id AS account_id, ev.name AS account_name, b.bpname, b.productname, b.projectname, SUM(b.opening_balance) AS opening_balance, SUM(b.activity_debit) AS activity_debit, SUM(b.activity_credit) AS activity_credit, SUM(b.closing_balance) AS closing_balance FROM base b JOIN acct_anc a ON a.leaf_id = b.account_id JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = a.anc_id WHERE ev.elementlevel = '__ACCOUNTLEVEL__' GROUP BY ev.value, ev.c_elementvalue_id, ev.name, b.bpname, b.productname, b.projectname ORDER BY ev.value

label.en_US: Opening Entry Amount to Initial Balance
label.es_ES: Importe del asiento de apertura al saldo inicial
